description:
Is this x402 seller a real business with paying users, or a farm / dead endpoint? Call it before your agent pays an unknown x402 endpoint. Returns verdict REAL / EMERGING / FARM / DEAD / UNKNOWN, action USE / CAUTION / AVOID, is_real, confidence, payers_30d, calls_30d, repeat-usage ratio (calls per payer) and the demand trend. Farms look like thousands of one-shot payers (calls/payer ~1.0); real businesses show repeat usage (calls/payer >= 3). Built from our daily sweep of the entire x402 catalog. An unknown seller returns UNKNOWN. For an agent (not an x402 seller) use should_i_pay. REST: GET /api/v1/bazaar/seller-verdict ($0.02).

Args:
    resource: full x402 resource URL (e.g. https://api.example.com/v1/foo)
    domain: or just a domain (e.g. api.example.com)
name: x402_seller_verdict
title: x402 seller verdict
